title: The daily board of one board day
description: site-data/boards/days/<board day>/daily.json, in version 1 of the RisingRepos data contract. The contract's README.md, in the RisingRepos repository at src/risingrepos/publishing/contract/, says how the files are laid out and how the contract changes. Every field is listed here and no other may appear. A field whose description starts with 'Untrusted' holds text a repository's owner wrote.

schema_version.description: The contract's version. It rises when a field is removed or changes what it holds.

board_day.description: The board day, as YYYY-MM-DD. The file's folder has the same name.

published_at.description: When this board day was first published, in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Publishing the board day again keeps it, so it says how old the board day is, not when the file was last written.

daily_job_started_at.description: When the daily job started work on this board day, in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ: the start of its first run for the snapshot day of the same date whose start, counted to the second, is no later than `published_at`. A run that failed and the runs after it count, so the time from this to `published_at` is how long the day's job took to publish the board. Null when no run of the daily job had started by `published_at`, counted to the second in the same way, as for a board day published by hand.

score_provisional.description: True while the score that ranked this board is provisional. The page then says so.

formula_version.description: The version of the scoring formula that ranked this board, a whole number. It rises whenever the formula changes, and every board day is then scored and published again, so the board days published together carry the same version. The page states it.

partial_days.description: The partial snapshot days that this board's ranking depended on, newest first, and none when it depended on none. A partial day lacks some repositories, so a repository missing from it may be ranked otherwise than a full day would rank it, or left off this board. Which days a ranking depends on is set by the formula that ranked the board, which `formula_version` names, and the RisingRepos repository's scoring module, src/risingrepos/scoring.py, gives the rule of the formula in use. The page then says so.

snapshot_day.description: The partial snapshot day, as YYYY-MM-DD, on or before the board day.

recent.description: True when the day falls within the recent pace: the last days up to and including the board day, over which the ranking measured how fast a repository gained stars, and whose number the formula that ranked the board sets. False when it falls only within a baseline, the pace a recent one is measured against.

state.description: Which of three kinds of board this is. 'rows': it holds no star band, and `rows` lists the repositories that rose. 'empty': it holds no star band and no repository rose, so `rows` is empty. 'held': it holds at least one star band, which `holds` names, and `rows` lists only the repositories that rose in the other bands, which may be none.

holds.description: The star bands this board leaves out, lowest first, and none when it leaves none out. A band is held when this board day's own snapshot missed some of the star counts the band spans, which `missed_stars` gives, so that the band is never ranked from only part of its repositories. A repository is in the band its star count on the board day falls in, and a count under the lowest band's least is in the lowest band. A board day whose snapshot was complete holds nothing.

least_stars.description: The fewest stars a repository in the band has.

most_stars.description: The most stars a repository in the band has, or null for the top band, which has no limit.

missed_stars.description: The star counts this board day's own snapshot missed, as runs of counts, lowest first: those at or above the day's star floor in which the collector did not read every repository it should have. Empty when the board day's snapshot was complete.

least_stars.description: The first star count of the run.

most_stars.description: The last star count of the run, or null when it runs on through every count above `least_stars`.

unranked.description: Each day before the board day that the ranking cannot rank a repository without a snapshot of, when that day's snapshot was partial or missing, newest first, and none when no such day was. Which days the ranking needs is set by the formula `formula_version` names.

snapshot_day.description: The day, as YYYY-MM-DD, before the board day.

status.description: 'partial' when that day's snapshot missed some repositories, and 'missing' when no snapshot of that day was kept at all.

repositories.description: How many repositories were left unranked for want of a snapshot on that day: each has a snapshot on the board day and history enough to be ranked, and none on that day. On a missing day that is every such repository, and none could be ranked.

rows.description: The board, in rank order. An empty board has no rows, and a board that holds a star band has none from that band.

rank.description: The row's place on the board: 1 for the first row, and one more for each row after it.

github_id.description: GitHub's numeric id for the repository. It stays the same when the repository is renamed or moves to another owner.

full_name.description: Untrusted: the owner chose it. The repository's owner and name, as owner/name, on the board day. The site links it to https://github.com/<full_name>. It holds only letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', and the one '/', so that address stays on GitHub.

description.description: Untrusted: the owner wrote it, and it can hold markup or an address. At most 350 characters: a longer one is cut to its first 349 and ends with '…'. Null when the repository has none, and never an empty string.

language.description: Untrusted: GitHub detects it from the owner's files, and the owner can override it. GitHub's name for the repository's main language. Null when GitHub names none, and never an empty string.

stars.description: The repository's star count on the board day.

score.description: The score that put the row on the board and gave it its rank: `recent_stars` divided by `recent_days`, then by `divided_by`. It and the six fields after it are as the formula that ranked the board, which `formula_version` names, worked them out. The RisingRepos repository's scoring module, src/risingrepos/scoring.py, gives the rule of the formula in use.

recent_stars.description: How many stars the score counted as gained in its recent days, which end on the board day.

recent_days.description: How many days `recent_stars` were gained over: the recent days the formula measures, less `days_left_out`.

days_left_out.description: How many of the recent days the score left out, because the repository lost more stars on them than the formula takes for real. 0 when it counted every one. Then `stars` less `recent_stars` is not the star count at the start of the recent days.

baseline.description: The repository's own pace before the recent days, in stars a day, as measured: what the score holds the recent pace against. It can be less than `divided_by`, nothing, or less than nothing for a repository that was losing stars.

divided_by.description: The stars a day that the recent pace, `recent_stars` over `recent_days`, is divided by to give `score`: `baseline`, or the least the formula divides by where `baseline` is less, so that a repository that gained almost nothing before is not scored as if it had.

excess.description: The stars the recent pace gained above `baseline` over the recent days the formula measures, a baseline less than nothing taken as nothing. Where `days_left_out` is not 0, the days counted stand in, at their own pace, for the days left out.
